fail.quote: Whether the poem moves you can only be judged when you read it, so it stays unverified until then.
fail.reason: The ending supplies mechanical checks but no task-specific qualitative rubric and observable passing verdict for an independent reviewer. Deferring to whether the owner is moved does not establish the required qualitative judge.

fail.quote: Author's revision rubric, a guide and not proof: every line holds a concrete particular or a turn, and no line explains the feeling.
fail.reason: The concrete qualitative criteria guide only the author’s revision. They are not assigned to an independent reviewer, and the owner’s eventual reading has no concrete rubric or passing verdict. Mechanical checks alone do not validate poetic quality.
